name: donut
description: A donut chart of up to six slices, biggest first, each labelled outside the ring with its share, and the total in the centre.

parameters.name: parts
parameters.description: list of 1 to 6 (label, value) pairs, every value above 0

parameters.name: total_label
parameters.description: text under the total in the centre; default none

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: outer radius of the ring in scene units

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.description: width of the ring in scene units, above 0 and below the radius

returns: VGroup with .slices (each VGroup(sector, leader, label), biggest first), .centre and .centre_point; grow(chart) fades them in
